summary: MCP launcher, runtime diagnostic, dispatch-readiness, run-discovery, and validation-run tools.

tools.notes: Read-only validation of an unpersisted proposed work-record dispatch contract. It does not mutate canonical records or admission evidence.
use_when: Operator needs readiness diagnostics for a proposed record before it is persisted.
do_not_use_when: The record is canonical; use workspace_validate_dispatch with its durable unit identifier.
authoritative_for: structural preflight of caller-supplied proposed record content

tools.display_name: Workspace Chassis Control Engine admission runtime diagnostic
tools.notes: Read-only agent-safe MCP route that diagnoses the running MCP server process (not the caller shell) for Chassis Control Engine worker_admission_v1 runtime config. Reports only source names and booleans (service URL, API key, worker-admission route, request-contract digest presence, and whether the remote-admission observability path is loaded); never returns any secret value, route value, digest, key hash, bearer material, project id, or request/response body.

Read-only introspection for the dispatch caller/session identity and bootstrap review contract. Identity authority must be launcher- or transport-minted; caller-supplied role identity is refused. Reports the current bootstrap state (bootstrap_exception_active / bootstrap_review_missing / bootstrap_exception_consumed). workspace_agent_dispatch is the active supported MCP dispatch surface.

paid_cce.notes: Read-only introspection for the dispatch caller/session identity and bootstrap review contract. Identity authority must be launcher- or transport-minted; caller-supplied role identity is refused. Reports the current bootstrap state (bootstrap_exception_active / bootstrap_review_missing / bootstrap_exception_consumed), and under a valid paid/CCE key posture the graph_impact_persistence_unavailable state for graph-impact evidence persistence prerequisites. workspace_agent_dispatch is the active supported MCP dispatch surface.

tools.notes: Preferred MCP dispatch-readiness surface for a WK or slice. Free/local readiness covers only the structural runnability floor: write_scope, acceptance, validation, supported role, resolvable subject, and fresh source digest. It never mutates canonical work records, lifecycle state, dispatch state, or result evidence, and never launches an agent. Compact by default; verbose:true restores the complete free/local envelope. CLI fallback is operator-only.
do_not_use_when: initiative_next_action before a unit is selected
requires_prior_state: role when validating a role-specific dispatch

paid_cce.notes: Preferred MCP dispatch-readiness surface for a WK or slice. When required graph impact is stale or missing, it refreshes the canonical current-HEAD graph and may write only ignored code-index graph artifacts, sibling atomic temporary files, the advisory build-lock file, and eight exclusively claimed candidate slots named .index.json.build-lock.json.slot-00.candidate through .index.json.build-lock.json.slot-07.candidate. Candidates are attempted only during the initial absent-lock race, retained but never reused or authoritative, and prevented by an existing persistent shared lock; exhaustion falls back to an independent atomic build. It never mutates canonical WK/evidence, admission sidecars, lifecycle or runtime state, dispatch/backend state, or result evidence, and never launches an agent. A bounded current-HEAD resolver failure preserves its safe typed code: verbose readiness includes graph_impact_failure, while compact output includes graph_impact_failure_code and the fixed remediation as next_action; raw causes are not exposed. Compact by default (decision code, bounded reasons, next action); verbose:true restores the full envelope. Under a valid paid/CCE key posture the readiness envelope also carries Node-Engine-returned admissibility detail: blast-radius level, cluster count, and the CCE verdict/reason codes and recovery. These are NE-returned judgments and are reported as such, distinguished from the raw measured carrier facts the local layer forwards; the local layer renders no threshold verdict of its own (DEC-0125). Set node_engine_admissibility:true to evaluate CCE-exclusive implementation admissibility for a structurally dispatchable unit; only the CCE pack path can return an admit and there is no local admit fallback. CLI fallback is operator-only.

tools.notes: Read-only current-process discovery for monitor handles lost after hot context compaction. Filter by optional subject and state active, terminal, or all. Results cover only caller-visible runs retained by this backend process; they are not durable, historical, cross-session, or restart recovery. Follow a returned handle with status or wait. After a cold restart, already-returned reviewer/redteam advisory text remains usable; do not re-dispatch, append, or repair its monitor to recover optional metadata or attestation.
use_when: Hot context compaction lost monitor handles while the same backend process is still running.
do_not_use_when: A monitor handle is already known; use workspace_agent_run_status or workspace_agent_run_wait.
The backend restarted and the completed reviewer/redteam advisory text was already returned; consume that text directly.
requires_prior_state: The same dispatch backend process remains running.

tools.notes: Orchestrator/operator process-spawn route for declared Node-test validation without raw shell or exec. Managed workers use workspace_worker_run_declared_test instead; its unit and worktree are launcher-bound. Supply exactly { unit, target }. The server loads the selected canonical unit and authorizes only targets declared by acceptance.validation[] entries shaped exactly as {operation: node_test, target, verification_ids}; strings and note objects never authorize execution. It then runs syntax check followed by the test only when syntax passes, using argv without a shell. Binary, workspace, environment, timeouts, output caps, source identity, and extra arguments are server-owned and caller overrides are refused. The target must be an existing canonical repo-relative JavaScript module inside the workspace and not escape through a symlink. Results are structured per-step advisory evidence, with the test marked skipped after syntax failure; they are not enforcement attestation or admission authority. Arbitrary commands, package scripts, and cross-repository validation are unsupported.
use_when: Run one Node test target declared by the selected canonical work-record unit.
do_not_use_when: The target is only named by a text note or is not declared by an exact current-contract validation object.
authoritative_for: selected-unit declared-test target authorization and confined execution evidence
requires_prior_state: A canonical work-record unit declares the exact node_test target in acceptance.validation[].

tools.notes: Worker-only launcher process-spawn capability for running one Node test declared by the worker's own unit before commit, including tests needing bare workspace-package imports. Supply exactly { target }; launcher-minted run identity binds the unit and dense worktree, and caller unit, record, repository, workspace, base, target set, or execution settings are refused. Only that bound unit's acceptance.validation[] entries shaped exactly as {operation: node_test, target, verification_ids} authorize the target; strings and note objects never authorize execution. The test runs launcher-side in a separate confined process, leaving the worker namespace and mutation set unchanged: the repository and write scope are read-only, secrets are masked, network is denied, the environment is launcher-minted, and only ephemeral temporary storage is writable. An identity-pinned read-only dependency mount may resolve workspace imports; if unavailable, stale, or mismatched, the run degrades with advisory evidence and dispatch is not refused. Binary, arguments, cwd, environment, timeout, and output bounds are launcher facts. Output retains byte-accounted stream heads and tails. Results are advisory only: they grant no admission, review, integration, or closure authority and do not replace findings-only review.

recommended_first_call.operation: run one launcher-bound declared node_test target

use_when: A managed worker needs to run one exact node_test target declared by its launcher-bound unit.
do_not_use_when: The caller needs to choose a unit, worktree, execution setting, or target not declared by the bound unit.
authoritative_for: launcher-bound managed-worker declared-test authorization and confined execution evidence
requires_prior_state: The launcher-bound unit declares the exact target in a current-contract acceptance.validation[] object.

paid_cce.notes: Worker-only launcher-owned capability that lets a managed implementation worker run one of its own unit's DECLARED node tests and read the output before committing (DEC-0158 clauses 3-4). A managed worker's namespace is exactly read_scope union write_scope with no dependency tree, so it cannot execute a test whose system under test imports a workspace package by bare specifier; this capability runs that test LAUNCHER-SIDE, in a separate bubblewrap-confined process against the run's own dense worktree, and returns the output. The worker's namespace is untouched: no new path is bound, mounted, stat-able, or readable inside it, and the worker's mutation set stays exactly its write_scope. Side effect: process_spawn. Caller input is exactly { target }. The unit and the worktree are bound from the dispatched run's launcher-minted identity binding, never from caller input; a caller-supplied unit, record, repo, workspace, worktree, cwd, base, or target set is refused rather than overridden, so a worker cannot select targets from another record's allowed[] or run against the landing checkout. The target is authorized solely from the BOUND unit's acceptance.validation[] entries shaped exactly as {operation: node_test, target, verification_ids}; text notes never authorize execution; an undeclared target is refused, never widened to something broader. Confinement: repository mounted READ-ONLY with no writable write_scope (so a test byproduct cannot reach the write scope or be staged into the delivery commit), secrets masked, network denied, launcher-minted clean env, and an ephemeral tmpfs as the only writable location. A launcher-owned read-only identity-pinned dependency mount makes bare-specifier workspace imports resolve (DEC-0178 clause 4: launcher-provided non-repository runtime infrastructure is not repository content and needs no scope declaration); an unavailable, stale, or mismatched dependency tree degrades that run and is recorded as advisory evidence, and never refuses a dispatch. Node binary, argv, cwd, env, timeout, and output bounds are launcher facts and cannot be supplied or overridden. Output retains the head AND the tail of each stream so a failing assertion's diagnostics survive a chatty passing run; the elided middle is byte-accounted. The result is advisory: it carries no admission, review, or closure authority, adds no admission metric, and never substitutes for the mandatory findings-only review or authorizes integration.
